name: Edge-Preserving Kawase Blur
aliases: Kawase Blur with Blue Noise Jittering
definition: A post-processing blur technique used to remove dither patterns introduced by blue noise jittering, while preserving cloud edge details.
summary: Edge-Preserving Kawase Blur removes blue noise dither patterns in volumetric rendering while preserving cloud edges by blurring high-frequency jitter instead of removing isolated outliers.
